text: シルフは　のっとられて　…　おわりかな

structure.jp: シルフは　のっとられて　…

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The られる ending says the thing was done to the subject by someone else. シルフは　のっとられて = 'Silph has been taken over, and'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means the speaker is wondering to themselves. おわりかな = 'I wonder if it's the end'.
